description: Cross-harness matrix suite for the networking plugin's 68 technology skills (routing/switching, firewall, DNS/IPAM, load balancing, VPN, SD-WAN, wireless, DC fabric, cloud networking, and network automation/monitoring vendors). Prompts are deliberately neutral (no reference to a skills library or documentation) so the no-skill arm is not tipped off. Every expected answer is traceable to cited content shipped in each skill's SKILL.md or references/ files as of 2026-08-08. knowledge: 'recent' = fact a bare model plausibly lacks (post-cutoff, version-gated, or niche); 'stable' = long-standing fact a strong bare model may already know.
